## Analysis by Restaurant

```{r analysis-by-restaurant}
# For each restaurant: total visits, unique customers,
# loyalty program visits, and total spend (food + alcohol, no tips).

q1 <- "
  SELECT
    r.restaurant_name                           AS Restaurant,
    COUNT(v.visit_id)                           AS TotalVisits,
    COUNT(DISTINCT v.customer_id)               AS UniqueCustomers,
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.loyalty_member = 1
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                 AS LoyaltyVisits,
    ROUND(SUM(v.food_bill + v.alcohol_bill), 2) AS TotalSpent
  FROM visits v
  JOIN restaurants r ON v.rid = r.rid
  LEFT JOIN customers c ON v.customer_id = c.customer_id
  GROUP BY r.restaurant_name
  ORDER BY r.restaurant_name;
"

res1 <- dbGetQuery(con, q1)

kable(res1,
      col.names = c("Restaurant", "Total Visits", "Unique Customers",
                    "Loyalty Visits", "Total Spent ($)"),
      format    = "latex",
      booktabs  = TRUE,
      caption   = "Summary of visits and revenue by restaurant") %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("striped", "hold_position", "scale_down"),
                font_size = 9)
```

## Sales and Visit Analytics

```{r sales-analytics}
# Dynamically find the 3 most recent years (no hard-coding of years)
years_df <- dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT DISTINCT YEAR(visit_date) AS yr
  FROM visits
  WHERE visit_date > '1970-01-01'
  ORDER BY yr DESC
  LIMIT 3;
")
yr_list <- paste(years_df$yr, collapse = ", ")

# Revenue = discounted food + alcohol (tips excluded)
# Discount is stored as a decimal proportion (e.g. 0.10 = 10% off)
q2 <- paste0("
  SELECT
    r.restaurant_name                                         AS Restaurant,
    ROUND(SUM(v.food_bill * (1 - v.food_discount_pct)
              + v.alcohol_bill), 2)                          AS TotalRevenue,
    ROUND(AVG(v.food_bill * (1 - v.food_discount_pct)
              + v.alcohol_bill), 2)                          AS AvgPerParty,
    ROUND(AVG(v.party_size), 1)                              AS AvgPartySize
  FROM visits v
  JOIN restaurants r ON v.rid = r.rid
  WHERE YEAR(v.visit_date) IN (", yr_list, ")
  GROUP BY r.restaurant_name
  ORDER BY r.restaurant_name;
")

res2 <- dbGetQuery(con, q2)

kable(res2,
      col.names = c("Restaurant", "Total Revenue ($)",
                    "Avg Spent / Party ($)", "Avg Party Size"),
      format    = "latex",
      booktabs  = TRUE,
      caption   = paste0("Sales analytics for years: ", yr_list)) %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("striped", "hold_position", "scale_down"),
                font_size = 9)
```

## Trend by Month for Florida

```{r florida-trend, fig.width=7, fig.height=4.5, fig.align="center"}
# Step 1: Find the 2 most recent years for Florida restaurants (no hard-coding)
fl_years <- dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT DISTINCT YEAR(v.visit_date) AS yr
  FROM visits v
  JOIN restaurants r ON v.rid = r.rid
  WHERE r.state = 'FL'
    AND v.visit_date > '1970-01-01'
  ORDER BY yr DESC
  LIMIT 2;
")
fl_yr_list <- paste(fl_years$yr, collapse = ", ")

# Step 2: Average monthly revenue across those 2 years for all FL restaurants
q3 <- paste0("
  SELECT
    sub.mn                          AS month_num,
    ROUND(AVG(sub.monthly_rev), 2)  AS avg_revenue
  FROM (
    SELECT
      YEAR(v.visit_date)                   AS yr,
      MONTH(v.visit_date)                  AS mn,
      SUM(v.food_bill + v.alcohol_bill)    AS monthly_rev
    FROM visits v
    JOIN restaurants r ON v.rid = r.rid
    WHERE r.state = 'FL'
      AND YEAR(v.visit_date) IN (", fl_yr_list, ")
      AND v.visit_date > '1970-01-01'
    GROUP BY yr, mn
  ) AS sub
  GROUP BY sub.mn
  ORDER BY sub.mn;
")

fl_data <- dbGetQuery(con, q3)

# Step 3: Plot the line chart
month_labels <- c("Jan","Feb","Mar","Apr","May","Jun",
                  "Jul","Aug","Sep","Oct","Nov","Dec")

plot(fl_data$month_num, fl_data$avg_revenue,
     type  = "b",
     pch   = 19,
     col   = "steelblue",
     lwd   = 2,
     xlab  = "Month",
     ylab  = "Avg Monthly Revenue ($)",
     main  = paste0("Florida Restaurants – Avg Monthly Revenue\n(",
                    paste(fl_years$yr, collapse = " & "), ")"),
     xaxt  = "n",
     xlim  = c(0.5, 12.5),
     ylim  = c(0, max(fl_data$avg_revenue, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.25),
     cex.main = 0.9)

# Custom x-axis with month abbreviations
axis(1, at = 1:12, labels = month_labels, cex.axis = 0.75)

# Data labels above each point
text(fl_data$month_num, fl_data$avg_revenue,
     labels = paste0("$", format(round(fl_data$avg_revenue), big.mark = ",")),
     pos = 3, cex = 0.55, col = "darkblue")

# Light grid lines for readability
grid(col = "gray85")
```
